thread:
tess: Quick sync  launching 'Lighthouse' as a narrow observability MVP for customers who need per-route cost + audit traces. Can we agree a razor-scope?

goran: Lean MVP: three small cards (p99 latency by route, cost/request, error rate). Exportable weekly ledger CSV with audit header.

anya: UI notes: compact card + single-row ledger view. Tenant picker, 1h/24h/7d presets. Export modal with transport choices (S3, SFTP).

sam: Runtime: emit span attrs route_id, model_family, cache_hit behind flag. Keep variant mapping short to avoid cardinality.

infra-bot: Reminder: new metric tags require metrics-schema ticket and cardinality billing note.

goran: Canary plan: 5% traffic in Dedicated pools for 48h. Metrics to watch: p99, error rate, ingestion lag, unique tag count. Rollback if p99 > 1.2x or unique tags exceed cap.

tess: Acceptance checklist draft:
- spans include route_id & cache_hit
- dashboard cards for Hosted + Dedicated
- ledger CSV with audit header (exported_by, ts, sha256) delivered to S3/SFTP
- canary runbook + rollback steps
- perf bench: tail overhead <=5%

anya: I'll upload mocks (compact + table) by Wed EOD.

sam: I'll open runtime PR with a small opt-in flag and a canonicalization map for route labels.

goran: I'll own canary runbook and monitoring thresholds. Draft by Mon.

infra-bot: Note: ingestion team needs canonicalization mapping before enabling flags. File ticket.

tess: Good. If we need to cut scope to land in one sprint, remove drill-to-traces from ship and add in sprint+1. Locking acceptance Thu. Thanks team :rocket:
